show: One Life One Chance with Toby Morse

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts

einzeiler: Mark Hoppus interviews Toby Morse about punk rock, life in H2O, and fatherhood.
kurzfassung: Mark Hoppus welcomes Toby Morse to his home for an in-depth conversation about his musical journey. Toby shares stories from his childhood, discovering hardcore punk, and forming the band H2O. They also discuss touring with his son Max on drums and navigating life as older musicians.
stichpunkte: Toby Morse reflects on growing up in Rhode Island and Maryland before moving to New York.
His brothers introduced him to punk rock and skateboarding, shaping his early influences.
He started as a roadie for New York hardcore bands before H2O formed from a live joke.
Toby's son Max now plays drums for H2O, creating a unique family dynamic on tour.
The conversation covers the contrasts between East Coast and West Coast hardcore scenes.
Toby and Mark discuss the emotional weight of growing up without a father and processing grief.
They touch upon health routines, aging in punk rock, and upcoming tour plans.

kapitel.titel: Moving to New York and Starting H2O
East Coast vs. West Coast Hardcore
Touring with Son Max on Drums

clips.hook: Finding Minor Threat and making a lifelong sobriety choice at 13
clips.text: Discovering Minor Threat at a young age provided a powerful message about staying drug-free and being yourself, leading to a lifelong personal commitment.

clips.hook: Witnessing people pull guns out at CBGB in the 90s
clips.text: Attending shows at CBGB during the nineties involved experiencing genuinely frightening situations, including seeing individuals draw weapons inside the venue.

clips.hook: Realizing on stage that your son is an incredible drummer
clips.text: Performing live alongside your child creates surreal moments of realization regarding their exceptional musical talent.

clips.hook: Modern hardcore bands proudly covering pop artists like Billie Eilish
clips.text: Contemporary punk and hardcore musicians boldly embrace diverse musical influences without fear of judgment from purists.

clips.hook: Doing all the wellness routines yet still battling anxiety and insomnia
clips.text: Maintaining an extreme health regimen involving supplements, yoga, and therapy does not automatically guarantee restful sleep or freedom from mental struggles.
